caveats: Single seed 42, TF-IDF family. Reference-free label QA is modeled as slice-rate outlier detection (z>2 vs other identity slices) -- the strongest QA available with NO trusted reference; a reference-BASED QA trivially catches any flip but needs the very external reference the defense commits. Slice toxic-rates differ naturally across identity terms, which is the spread the organic low end hides within.
verdict: Spectrum (slice 'muslim', TF-IDF, nested doses). Reference-free label QA (flag a slice at train toxic-rate z>2.0 vs other identity slices, spread 0.19+/-0.06) first fires at poison=0.05; certification stays blind at EVERY dose. There is a genuine EVADES-BOTH regime up to poison=0.0 (harm already 2% vs 2.2% clean, certified, and NOT a label-QA outlier): the organic lower end evades both post-hoc certification and reference-free pre-training label QA. The deliberate high-fraction end (poison>=0.05) is the VISIBLE upper end -- caught by reference-free label QA, not by certification. A reference-BASED QA would catch any poison>0, but that trusted per-slice reference is exactly the external reference the defense commits; absent it, both detectors fail together on the organic end. Demonstrates the asserted spectrum as a continuum.
